extracted.name: Peanut butter & banana waffles
extracted.description: Great recipe for Peanut butter & banana waffles.
ingredient_lines: 3 tsp salt 3/4 cup creamy peanut butter
instruction_lines: In a large bowl,whisk flour,sugar,baking powder and salt. Place peanut butter in another bowl; gradually whisk in oil. Whisk in eggs and milk. Add to dry ingredients;stir just until moistened. Stir in bananas
Bake in preheated waffle iron according to manufacturers directions until golden brown.
